metadata.title: Fate of the remnant in tidal stripping event: repeating and non-repeating

notes: No eligible stars. The named sources in Table 2 (T:p15-b0) are repeating pTDE event candidates in bound systems, not individually identified Galactic unbound stars. The potentially ejected remnants are generic polytropic simulation outcomes without stellar identifiers (e.g., T:p5-b16).
